faq.question: Will I always appear Active on Teams or Slack?
faq.answer: No. NoAway prevents this computer from entering an idle state while it is running, which helps during long tasks such as downloads, builds, or presentations. It does not control calendar status, a locked screen, company policy, or other devices.

faq.question: Is using NoAway safe?
faq.answer: Yes. NoAway is a simple desktop utility that runs locally. It does not access files, read messages, or track personal data.

faq.question: How do I stop Microsoft Teams from showing away?
faq.answer: Microsoft Teams switches to Away when it detects no keyboard or mouse activity. NoAway keeps this computer from going idle, which is the signal Teams uses. Available is not guaranteed.

faq.question: How to keep Teams stay active?
faq.answer: Use an app that keeps Teams active, such as NoAway. It simulates natural activity so your system does not go idle.

faq.question: How to keep the Teams icon green?
faq.answer: The Teams icon turns green when Teams detects system activity, and yellow after about 5 minutes without input. NoAway keeps this computer from going idle while Keep Active is on. A green icon is not guaranteed.

faq.question: What should I do if Teams still shows Away?
faq.answer: Make sure NoAway is running and Keep Active is enabled. Update to the latest version and restart the activity engine from the tray menu.
